headline: Canada and China expand trade agreements, and Xi meets Carney ahead of APEC summit
summary: China will reduce tariffs on more Canadian export products, including pork and seafood, as Xi Jinping meets Prime Minister Carney ahead of the APEC summit.
why: Canada and China are major agricultural and resource trading partners, so tariff changes on food exports directly affect Canadian producers' market access.
original_headline: Canadá y China amplían acuerdos comerciales y Xi se reúne con Carney antes de la cumbre de APEC
